phase: P1 offline data models and Clock only

tasks.interface: ClockSample(UTC i64 milliseconds, monotonic u64 milliseconds), Clock trait, SystemClock, FiniteWindow, MonotonicBudget; immutable in-flight expiry and decreasing remaining budget
Standalone GoalAuthoritySource/Reference/Validity/Deadline/Termination models, strict new serde shapes, existing legacy Contract/AuthorityEvidence unchanged
pure RFC3339-to-UTC-ms normalization, exact precision rejection, FiniteWindow validation, descriptive digest; no authorization/enforcement/storage writes
tasks.tests: inline authority::tests, then repository --lib and original formal workspace verification

rulings.decision: Use exact millisecond UTC and monotonic values; reject finer timestamp precision instead of rounding notBefore earlier or expiresAt later.
rulings.reason: Core uses std time and existing dependencies; repository already has chrono. No Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock scope expansion.
rulings.costIfWrong: Interface precision may need a future reviewed additive revision; no runtime enforcement is activated.

rulings.decision: Issuer/actor/source fields remain descriptive metadata; validation never returns an authorization decision.
rulings.reason: P1 excludes actual identity authentication, goal coverage and P2 enforcement.
rulings.costIfWrong: Later phases must still supply trusted identity and explicit coverage before execution.

interfaceChecks: Protocol wire timestamps are RFC3339 strings; repository normalizes exact milliseconds into core FiniteWindow.
Legacy readable evidence has no added required fields; new models are standalone and opt into strict finite shape.
No current source/grant head, CAS, live grant or action hook is introduced.

commandBounds.executor: GNU timeout, standard foreground process; no copied legacy supervisor
